questions.question:
Select the number-pair in which the two numbers are related in the same way as are the two numbers of the following number-pair.

8 : 128
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

8² + 8² = 64 + 64 = 128

Similarly,

122 + 122 = 144 + 144 = 288

Hence, the correct answer is 288.

questions.question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the gaps of the given letter series will complete the series.

c c _ _ p l o p c _ _ r p l o _ c _ c _ p l _ p c

options.text: p r c c p c r r
c r p c p r r o
c r p c p c r o
c r c c p c r o

questions.solution:
Let's check each option:

1) c c __**p**__ __**r**__ p l o p c __**c**__ __**c**__ r p l o __**p**__ c __**c**__ c __**r**__ p l __**r**__ p c → doesn't follow a pattern

2) c c __c__ __r__ p l o p c __p__ __c__ r p l o __p__ c __r__ c __r__ p l **__o__** p c → doesn't follow a pattern

3) c c __c__ __r__ p l o p c __p__ __c__ r p l o __p__ c __c__ c __r__ p l __o__ p c → doesn't follow a pattern

4) c c __c__ __r__ p l o p / c __c__ __c__ r p l o __p__ / c __c__ c __r__ p l __o__ p c → follows a pattern

Hence, the correct answer is c r c c p c r o

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set.

(140, 85, 115)
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

(140, 85, 115) → 140 ÷ 5 = 28 and 115 ÷ 5 = 23; (28 + 23) ÷ 3 = 51 ÷ 3 = 17 × 5 = 85 the middle term.

Similary, 

(115, 65, 80) → 115 ÷ 5 = 23 and 80 ÷ 5 = 16; (23 + 16) ÷ 3 = 39 ÷ 3 = 13 and 13 × 5 = 65 the middle term.

Hence, the correct answer is (115, 65, 80)

questions.question:
Two statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some autos are cycles.

All cycles are trucks.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some trucks are autos.

II. Some trucks are cycles.

III. Some cycles are autos.

options.text: Only conclusions I and II follow
Only conclusions II and III follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5b318a82f7997bd0a993224f3866d58010595866c89fda334652d371e1ceee93.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. Some trucks are autos → True (Those autos which are cycles are trucks.)

II. Some trucks are cycles → True (all cycles are trucks).

III. Some cycles are autos → True (some autos are cycles.)

Hence, the correct answer is 'all conclusions follow'.

questions.question:
Which two signs should be interchanged in the following equation to make it correct?

612 ÷ 36 – 12 × 88 + 208 = 324
questions.solution:
Given equation: 612 ÷ 36 – 12 × 88 + 208

After Interchanging × and –

612 ÷ 36 × 12 - 88 + 208

= 17 × 12 - 88 + 208 

= 204 – 88 + 208

= 412 – 88

= 324

Hence, the correct answer is × and –.

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set.

(64, 7, 27)
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

(64, 7, 27) → 64 = 4³ and 27 = 3³; 4 + 3 = 7

Similarly,

(216, 11, 125) → 216 = 63 and 125 = 53; 6 + 5 = 11

Hence, (216, 11, 125) is the correct answer.

questions.question: A total sum of Rs. 209 is distributed among three friends A, B and C in such a way that A gets six times rupees than B, C gets 4 times rupees than B. How many rupees does A get?
questions.solution:
Given that:

A + B + C = 209 ...... (i)

A = 6B ......(ii)

C = 4B .......(iii)

From (i), (ii) and (iii),

6B + B + 4B = 209

⇒11B = 209

⇒ B = 209 ÷ 11

⇒ B = 19

Therefore, A = 6 × 19 = 114

Hence, A gers 114 rupees.

questions.question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown below, the six faces of which are numbered 1 to 6. Find the number opposite to the face having 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/084e193d95a6b46c3ca83f2f82d3805713ef3feeb43566cd26ef3360b4ce4883.png]
questions.solution:
3 and 6 are adjacent to 4 in the first position of the dice.

1 and 5 are adjacent to 4 in the second position of the dice.

Now, the only number left is 2.

Thus, 4 must be opposite to 2.

Hence, the number opposite to the face having 2 is 4.
